name: When should I call a professional for water damaged wood floors?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for water damaged wood floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional restoration company immediately after discovering water damage to your wood floors, especially if the water source was significant, the damage covers a large area, or the water has been present for more than a few hours. Professionals, like those serving San Fernando or Studio City, have specialized equipment for water extraction, industrial-grade drying, and moisture detection to ensure hidden moisture is addressed and to prevent secondary damage like mold. Early intervention can significantly reduce overall repair costs and prevent long-term issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional immediately for significant or prolonged water damage to wood floors, or if the area is large, to ensure proper drying and prevent mold.
